name: Kakania
bio: Archetype: Damage Allocation, Tank, Assist Burst. ⌽ Takes 50% of damage dealt to allies from enemy attacks and stores damage taken as [Empathy]. ⌽ Heals the team when storing enough [Empathy] and deals AOE Genesis damage when receiving heals based on current [Empathy]. ⌽ S1 deals additional Genesis damage based on current [Empathy]. ⌽ S2 can self-heal based on max HP or grant one ally an ATK buff based on current [Empathy]. ⌽ Ult deals [Empathy]-based Genesis damage resets [Empathy] and at turn end, deals additional Genesis damage equal to a percentage of DMG Taken by the enemy that turn.
